$comment: Tool registry of the Milestone 3 scenarios. The code.* rows describe the real V10 coding tools (packages/agent-core/src/coding), which the scenario registers as they are; the declared class is the tool's floor, and code.git raises it per operation (commit and branch: write, git_write; push: write, git_push).

tools.name: code.git
tools.note: Reads for status, diff and log; commit and branch are write (git_write), push is write (git_push). Receipts keep the approval kind as their kind.
